name: What is window weatherproofing and why is it important for homes in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What is window weatherproofing and why is it important for homes in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Window weatherproofing involves sealing and insulating your windows to prevent air leaks and moisture intrusion. For Bay Area homes, this is crucial due to varying coastal and inland temperatures, occasional fog, and potential for rain. Proper weatherproofing enhances indoor comfort by maintaining stable temperatures, reduces energy bills by preventing heat loss in winter and heat gain in summer, and protects against moisture-related issues like mold and mildew, extending the life of your windows and home structure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Window weatherproofing seals and insulates windows to prevent air leaks and moisture, crucial for Bay Area homes to improve comfort, reduce energy costs, and prevent damage.
